events.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — August 31
events.summary: This week, GitHub Copilot expands model choice and content protections, while VS Code adds new ways to manage agent sessions and get pull requests merge-ready. For more information, see our list of all supported models.

events.title: GPT-6 Astra is generally available in GitHub Copilot
events.summary: GPT-6 Astra from OpenAI is now available in GitHub Copilot. OpenAI’s latest general-purpose model, GPT-6 Astra, is designed for long-horizon, autonomous coding and agentic tasks.
